name: edit-studio
description: Video editing in code (Python + ffmpeg): music edits from a track and footage in a style named in plain words (fresh versions on request), composite edits (a talk clip cut by spoken words into a music edit), remakes from a reference, named effects measured from example clips, a library of 268 editing moves and 15 genres, captions and subtitles, translation and voiceover, missing shots or a whole video generated with Higgsfield.
